lead: A single-line input, with its behaviour from Base UI's Input (inside a [Field](/field) it gets validation and the a11y links automatically). Multi-line input is Textarea; prefixes and suffixes go in an InputGroup. The examples follow the Input, TextArea and InputGroup pages of the HeroUI docs.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `outline` matches HeroUI v3's primary (white with a shadow), `filled` its secondary (grey).

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: HeroUI v3 has no sizes; this package adds them: 32 / 36 / 40px.

types.title: Types
types.description: `type` is the native attribute, passed through as is.

invalid.title: Invalid
invalid.description: On its own, mark it with `invalid`; inside a Field, the Field's validation decides — see the [Field](/field) page.

read-only.title: Read Only
read-only.description: The native `readOnly`, with no special look; theme styles can tone it down with `:read-only`.

textarea.title: Textarea
textarea.description: The same Base UI Input rendered as a `<textarea>`: it looks like Input and can be resized vertically by default.

textarea-auto.title: Auto size
textarea-auto.description: Grows with the content; `{ minRows, maxRows }` sets the range, and beyond `maxRows` the height is fixed and it scrolls inside. With it on, the textarea can't be resized by dragging.

textarea-count.title: Character count
textarea-count.description: `showCount` shows the character count below; with `maxLength` it reads "n / max" and changes color at the limit. Works together with `autoSize`.

input-group.title: Prefix & Suffix
input-group.description: The group draws the background and the focus ring, and the input inside is transparent; theme styles read the focus, invalid and disabled states from the input with `:has()`.

input-group-password.title: Password Toggle
input-group-password.description: A button in the suffix: a Button in a group is the same component as any other Button.

password-input.title: PasswordInput
password-input.description: InputGroup + a button that shows the text (an `aria-pressed` toggle whose name follows the state).

search-input.title: SearchInput
search-input.description: A search icon, a clear button when there is text, and a search button. <kbd>Enter</kbd> or the button calls `onSearch`, <kbd>Esc</kbd> clears, and nothing fires while `loading`.

tag-input.title: TagInput
tag-input.description: <kbd>Enter</kbd> or a comma adds a tag, <kbd>Backspace</kbd> in an empty input removes the last one, and pasted text is split on the separators; see also `max` / `validate` / `allowDuplicates`.

api.title: API Reference
api.affixes: `InputGroup.Prefix` / `InputGroup.Suffix` take a span's native props and hold what goes before / after the input (icons, text, buttons); `InputGroup.Action` is a small icon button in the suffix position, and needs an `aria-label`.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: The components have no styles and only write hooks; theme styles style them in `input.css`, and focus, hover and the placeholder use the native pseudo-classes.
styling.slot: Structure hooks (`input-group-action` is the icon button in the suffix, `input-group-tags` TagInput's tag area)
styling.variants: Variant hooks; inside a Field they take the Field's defaults
styling.states: State hooks, written by Base UI (the `invalid` prop also writes `data-invalid`)
styling.pseudoClasses: Theme styles handle them with the native pseudo-classes
